svg.text: Figure 9.3. The state record: 68 words of 128 bits, one format for the host, the Tracer and the replayer
v1.3 (spec §4.19.2 at v1.26.1, §4.21.2) — byte offsets 0x000–0x43F of the region; narrow fields widened, not to scale
words 4–64 (0x040–0x40F): registers 4–125, two to a word, not shown
template bitmap: bit i set if the run used controller-fed inline template i (an output; a write is ignored)
at the end of run n: window n+1's start (to tile n+1)
the live advice count (state, carried on)
the pc at the window's first row; live while the Tracer runs
that row's index in the committed bytecode; live
the rows of the first instruction's expansion already run
v1.25's compression flags: written 0 and ignored, not reused
v1.26's per-pass flags, now RUN_CONFIG [24], [25]: written 0, ignored
code, read log, write log: 128-bit words as sent, padding included
the Tracer, when the rows end
code, read log, write log: the values each stream decodes to
the Tracer, when the rows end
code, read log, write log: LRU-coded (1) or raw (0), set 1's choice
the Tracer, when the rows end
the segment's advice values (frame 3's count) at load; one less per pop
the Tracer; C&C 3 at the end
word 2 + i: register 2i in [63:0], 2i + 1 in [127:64]; the live register file
[30:0], [32:31]: the Tracer's copy of the guest's memory (.pages)
the proof's RAM size in 8-byte cells: K for the range check
0x8000_0000 − lowest_address, exact in bytes: the .pages offset, the range check, the keys
bit i: the run used controller-fed inline template i (inlines only)
At the end of run n the record is read out in place, as output queue 0, in four transfers (4.21.6): words 0 and 2–66 are window n+1's start, sent to tile n+1;
word 1's three output fields and word 67 are run n's totals, sent to tile n with its streams. Nothing writes a state between runs. Word 1's advice field is state:
the segment's advice still unconsumed, one less per value popped (a pop at 0 is advice underflow, ERRORS [4]), and C&C 3 checks it is 0 after the 64th run.
The replayer ignores words 66 and 67 and word 1's advice field. Frame 2 of the segment file takes the same layout (§23).
The state record is one format from the host through the Tracer to the replayers: 68 words of 128 bits at byte offsets 0x000–0x43F, loaded state word first,
whose write resets the unit. It is the Tracer's working state, so at the end of each run it is read out in place: purple fields are window n+1's start,
blue fields run n's totals, and the advice field is the live count of the segment's advice.
Source: spec/machine-spec.md §4.19.2 (v1.26.1), §4.21.2 (to 66f399e), §4.21.6; DECISIONS-v1.26.md items 2, 15–17; DECISIONS-v1.3.md §23, §24. Review: wip/planning/sessions/WORKER24-NOTES.md.
